01:58 to 03:57 is 1 hour 59 minutes later, so subtracting 03:57 − 01:58 in wrap-around time-of-day terms means finding the duration from 03:57 back to 01:58 the same day, which is negative, so add 24 hours.

03:57 − 01:58 = (03:57 − 01:58) = 1 hour 59 minutes positive difference if 03:57 is later, but here subtraction is time-of-day wrap-around:  
Compute (01:58 − 03:57) mod 24 hours.

01:58 − 03:57 = −1:59  
−1:59 + 24:00 = 22:01.

FINAL_ANSWER: 22:01
